# Viko

> Viko is a free, open source, browser-based video editor. It runs entirely in the browser with no accounts, no uploads and no cloud rendering: users import media from their device, edit on a frame-precise multi-track timeline with keyframes, color grading, captions and effects, then export MP4 offline.

Important notes:
- Viko is built with SvelteKit and runs completely client-side in the browser. Projects, media and version snapshots are stored locally in IndexedDB and localStorage.
- The editor is free and open source under the Apache License 2.0. Source code lives at https://github.com/pimatis/viko.
- Viko is a desktop-first tool: timeline editing, keyframes, grading and export are tuned for a large display, mouse and keyboard.
- No accounts, no tracking, no cloud uploads. Media never leaves the user's machine.

## Pages

- [Viko homepage](https://github.com/pimatis/viko): Overview of the product and features, workflow, FAQ, privacy and terms.
- [Privacy policy](https://github.com/pimatis/viko): What data Viko stores on the device (IndexedDB, localStorage) and what never leaves it.
- [Terms of service](https://github.com/pimatis/viko): Apache 2.0 license terms and contribution guidelines.
